stem:
Aisha's class sorts samples of rock, mineral pieces, and objects made from metals such as iron and copper. They also discuss why rocks should not be wasted.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Rocks are made up of minerals, and important metals such as iron and copper are extracted from minerals.
Rocks take thousands to millions of years to form, so they should be conserved and used responsibly.
Minerals are made up of rocks.

teacher.key_rationale: Rocks are made of minerals; metals are extracted from minerals; rocks form slowly and need responsible use. Statement 3 reverses the rock–mineral relation.
